channel.title: Precision instruments: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the precision instruments sector.

item.title: Sos Lab: Sos Lab signed a KRW 8.70bn contract to develop and supply autonomous driving and Physical AI lidar to a North American big tech firm.
Kctech: Kctech signs KRW 69.9bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK Hynix, equal to 18.26% of recent revenue.
Kctech: KC Tech signed a KRW 21.1bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK hynix, equal to 5.52% of recent revenue.
Kctech: KC Tech reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 114.2bn and operating profit of KRW 20.2bn, up 19.0% and 35.8% year on year.
Di: DI Corp's preliminary Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 217.7bn, up 99.6% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 59.3bn.
